column60: A Pb-Pb date of 1199 +/- 70 Ma on lacustrine carbonate within the Stac Fada Member (Turnbull et al., 1996) and an Ar-Ar date of 1177 +/- 5 Ma on authigenic K-feldspar precipitated in degassing pipes associated with the impact ejecta (Parnell et al., 2011) constrain the Stac Fada Member, midway through the Stoer Group. Because the duration of deposition is unknown and the pole position appears to progress through the section, the rock age is uncertain; the pole is assigned **ca. 1199 Ma (1129-1269 Ma)**.
